recognize_zh: 脫色後的骨髓印片進行免疫染色：左圖大型異常淋巴球呈強棕色 CD20 陽性，右圖同類大細胞呈較淡的膜狀 CD10 陽性，而周圍小型背景細胞為陰性，支持 CD10+ 大 B 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Two-panel composite of immunoperoxidase stains performed on destained bone marrow imprint smears
Left panel: large cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining (CD20) among negative smaller cells
Right panel: weaker membranous staining of large cells (CD10) with many negative background cells
Granular brown background deposits and bubbles/vacuoles typical of smear-based IHC
Morphologic detail limited by destaining and smear-based immunostaining
describe_en: Immunohistochemistry performed on destained bone marrow imprint smears is shown in two panels. The large atypical lymphoid cells show strong staining for CD20 (left) and membranous staining for CD10 (right), whereas smaller background hematopoietic cells are negative. Background granular deposition is present, and cytologic detail is limited by the smear-based technique. In conjunction with the imprint morphology, findings are compatible with bone marrow involvement by a CD10-positive large B-cell lymphoma (germinal center B-cell-like), with MYC/BCL2 status required to exclude high-grade B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are medium-sized, CD10+ BCL6+ BCL2-negative with near-100% Ki-67 and isolated MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements
ddx.vs: Morphology and CD20/CD10 cannot separate it; FISH for MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 is required.
B-lymphoblasts are CD10+ but TdT+ and CD34+ with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and are often CD20 weak or negative.
